done_when: A refusal that carries review finding text or a review engine error prints exactly as written, with braces and JSON intact, and no error is raised.
why: Forge crashes while printing a refusal when a review finding or a review engine error contains curly braces, such as {role}, or JSON, so a client sign-off ends in an error after round 1 and the owner's stop question can be hidden (issue 1038 is the same fault).
